flags: The board approved a special cash dividend of about US$1.95 per ordinary share and per ADS, payable on or about December 4, 2026 to holders of record on November 23, 2026.

The board approved a three-year annual dividend policy. The company plans to distribute annual dividends of no less than 50% of the preceding year's net income, starting with the financial year ending in 2027.

The company completed its initial public offering of Class A ordinary shares in the form of ADSs in April 2025. All preferred shares converted automatically into Class A ordinary shares, and the ADSs began trading on Nasdaq under CHA.

news.headline: CHAGEE opens first Philippine flagship store in BGC, blending tea craftsmanship with Filipino culture
news.quote: officially opened its first Philippine flagship store

touches.claim: The network kept growing in 2026, with 7,639 teahouses at June 30, 2026, an 8.5% increase from a year earlier. Overseas is a growth area, with GMV up 114.3% year over year, while Greater China GMV declined.

Teahouse network expansion is the stated revenue driver: the network grew from 6,440 to 7,453 teahouses in 2025, a net increase of 1,013. For it to continue, the company must keep finding sites, partners and funding, and new openings must not cannibalise existing stores.

Overseas expansion is a growth driver: overseas teahouses rose to 345 from 156, and overseas GMV in Q2 2026 rose 114.3% year over year to RMB504.0 million. For this to continue, overseas stores must hold their sales, since overseas same-store GMV growth was negative in late 2025.

news.why: Chagee opened its first Philippine flagship store, marking incremental progress in its overseas teahouse expansion.

touches.claim: The network kept growing in 2026, with 7,639 teahouses at June 30, 2026, an 8.5% increase from a year earlier. Overseas is a growth area, with GMV up 114.3% year over year, while Greater China GMV declined.

business_model.claim: Chagee sells freshly-made tea drinks through a teahouse network that is mostly franchised: 6,838 of 7,453 teahouses were franchised at the end of 2025.
quotes: We primarily operate our business through an extensive franchise network.

business_model.claim: Most revenue comes from franchised teahouses: 88.5% of 2025 net revenues, down from 93.8% in 2024. Company-owned teahouses supplied 11.5%.
quotes: We generate most of our net revenues through our franchised teahouses.

business_model.claim: The franchisee customer pays in two ways. Sales of products to franchised teahouses (raw materials, packaging, equipment) are the larger part, and franchising and other services (royalties, initial fees, brand license fees) are the smaller part.
quotes: We generate net revenues from sales of products by supplying raw materials, such as tea leaves and dairy, as well as packaging materials used to make our tea drinks, to our franchised teahouses.

business_model.claim: Part of the franchise fees depend on franchised stores' GMV, so store sales feed Chagee's revenue and profit.
quotes: Other fees are calculated as a percentage of the franchised teahouses’ GMVs, including trademark licensing fees, promotional service fees, supply chain management service fees, technology service fees, and operations management fees.

business_model.claim: Company-owned teahouses sell drinks directly to consumers. Their revenue rose to 1,490,316 in 2025 from 773,208 in 2024 (table in thousands, RMB), as the count rose to 615 from 169.
quotes: We also generate net revenues by offering a variety of freshly-made tea drinks directly to consumers at our company-owned teahouses.

business_model.basis: inferred from the revenue disaggregation lines in the income statement and Item 5 table
business_model.claim: Reporting segments: the income statement splits revenue into franchised teahouses and company-owned teahouses, and 2025 total net revenues were 12,907,407 (table in thousands, RMB). The packet does not say whether these are formal reportable segments.
Network expansion is the main stated revenue driver. Teahouses grew to 7,453 at the end of 2025 from 6,440 a year earlier.
quotes: The expansion of our teahouse network is a key driver of our revenue growth and operating efficiency.

business_model.claim: Sales per store are falling and offset network growth. Average monthly GMV per teahouse in China was RMB 387 thousand in FY2025 against 512 in FY2024, and same-store GMV growth was (24.2)%. Franchised revenue still fell 1.9%.
quotes: as reflected in the decrease in average monthly GMV per teahouse in China in recent quarters and the deceleration or decline in quarterly same-store GMV growth

business_model.claim: Equipment sales to new franchised stores move with the opening pace. They fell to RMB357.4 million in 2025 from RMB898.0 million in 2024 as openings slowed.
quotes: As the expanding pace slowed down in 2025, newly opened franchised teahouses in 2025 decreased compared with those in 2024, which resulted in a drop of net revenues from sales of teahouse equipment and other supplies to RMB357.4 million (US$51.1 million) in 2025 from RMB898.0 million in 2024.

business_model.claim: The largest cost is cost of materials, storage and logistics, which was 6,001,463 in 2025 (table in thousands, RMB). It fell to 46.4% of net revenues from 50.4%, because of revenue and product mix, recipe upgrades and supplier terms.
quotes: Among these, the cost of materials, storage and logistics related to the purchase of raw materials, packaging and equipment is the most significant component of our cost structure

business_model.basis: stated in the cited items; the share-based compensation comparison is read from the cash flow table
business_model.claim: Operating costs grew faster than revenue in 2025: total operating expenses rose to 89.6% of net revenues from 76.7%, and income from operations fell to 1,347,237 from 2,886,599 (table in thousands, RMB). G&A of 2,450,379 was a large contributor.
quotes: due to our continued investment in the global corporate infrastructure to support international expansion

business_model.claim: Consumers order through Chagee's own mobile mini program and through third-party delivery platforms, and the company says a meaningful part of revenue comes through the platforms.
quotes: we derive a meaningful portion of our revenue from orders fulfilled through third-party delivery platforms

business_model.claim: The network is mainly in China, with a small but growing overseas base: 7,108 teahouses in China and 345 overseas at the end of 2025.
quotes: As of December 31, 2025, our network included 7,108 teahouses in 32 out of 34 province-level divisions across China, as well as 345 teahouses overseas.

business_model.claim: Recent quarter: in Q2 2026 company-owned stores supplied 27.5% of net revenues (RMB940.6 million, against RMB311.2 million a year earlier) while franchised revenue fell to RMB2,474.0 million from RMB3,020.7 million, which the company attributes to lower Greater China GMV.
quotes: This was mainly attributable to a decrease in total GMV in Greater China resulting from the economic headwinds as well as intense industry competition.

competitive_position.claim: Chagee has a large, mostly franchised teahouse network: 7,108 teahouses across China, 345 overseas, and 6,838 franchised ones, as of December 31, 2025.
quotes: As of December 31, 2025, our network included 7,108 teahouses in 32 out of 34 province-level divisions across China, as well as 345 teahouses overseas.

competitive_position.claim: The revenue mix is shifting toward company-owned teahouses. Franchised teahouses supplied 88.5% of net revenues in 2025, against 93.8% in 2024 and 94.7% in 2023.
quotes: We generate most of our net revenues through our franchised teahouses.

competitive_position.claim: Revenue growth slowed to 4.0% in 2025 and was driven by company-owned teahouses. Franchised teahouse revenue fell 1.9%.
quotes: Our net revenues were RMB12,907.4 million (US$1,845.7 million) in 2025, representing a 4.0% increase from RMB12,405.6 million in 2024, primarily driven by the increase in net revenues generated from our company-owned teahouses.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (operating data table); causes are as the company describes them
competitive_position.claim: Store-level performance fell sharply in 2025. Average monthly GMV per teahouse in China dropped from 512 to 387 (RMB thousand), and same-store GMV growth was (24.2) percent, so unit productivity is eroding.
quotes: Our operational performance is subject to ongoing downward pressure and may further decline for a number of reasons and some of them are beyond our control, including decreasing consumer spending, increasing competition, increasing price sensitivity among consumers.

competitive_position.claim: Procurement scale has helped the cost position. Cost of materials, storage and logistics fell to 46.4% of net revenues in 2025 from 50.4% in 2024.
quotes: Our scale enables us to gain more bargaining power over suppliers, which we believe will further lower our costs and expenses as a percentage of our net revenues.

competitive_position.claim: Profitability fell in 2025 even though the supply chain cost improved. Income from operations was 1,347,237 against 2,886,599 in 2024 (table in thousands of RMB), and total operating expenses rose to 89.6% of net revenues from 76.7%.
quotes: increased to 89.6% in 2025, compared to 76.7% in 2024

competitive_position.claim: Company-owned teahouse expansion is dilutive for now. Operating costs rose 111.7%, faster than the 92.7% growth in revenue from those teahouses, as new teahouses ramped up.
quotes: This growth in cost outpaced the 92.7% increase in net revenues from company-owned teahouses during the same period.

competitive_position.claim: Delivery-platform price wars are a named competitive threat, and the company chose to hold prices rather than match discounts.
quotes: In the short term, such subsidies may attract our customers to lower-priced alternatives, placing downward pressure on our sales.
we decided to gravitate towards maintaining our product pricing and premium brand positioning

competitive_position.claim: The product is easy to imitate. Recipes are not patented, and new well-funded entrants are a possibility.
quotes: Our recipes are not patented, and we are unable to prevent competitors from copying our products and selling similar products.

competitive_position.claim: Results depend heavily on franchise partners, over whom Chagee has limited control, so their financial health is a competitive vulnerability.
quotes: As we generate the vast majority of our net revenues through these franchised teahouses, their financial success and cooperation are critical to our overall success.

competitive_position.claim: Weakness continued into 2026. Second-quarter 2026 average monthly GMV per teahouse in Greater China was RMB338,259 against RMB356,080 in the first quarter, and active members fell to 47.1 million from 50.0 million.
quotes: Average monthly GMV per teahouse in Greater China was RMB338,259 in the second quarter of 2026, compared to RMB356,080 in the first quarter of 2026.
Chagee had 47.1 million active members in the second quarter of 2026, compared to 50.0 million in the first quarter of 2026.

competitive_position.claim: The network kept growing in 2026, with 7,639 teahouses at June 30, 2026, an 8.5% increase from a year earlier. Overseas is a growth area, with GMV up 114.3% year over year, while Greater China GMV declined.
quotes: representing an 8.5% increase in the number of teahouses as of June 30, 2025
